data.title: Head Chef
data.summary: Lead a small kitchen team preparing lunches and catering services. The role also involves developing the food offering and catering business.

requirements.text: At least 3 years as a head chef or shift supervisor in Finland
requirements.question: Would someone who has done head chef or shift supervisor work, with fewer than 3 years, be worth a conversation?
requirements.why: The posting requires prior head chef or shift supervisor experience gained in Finland.

requirements.text: Ability to independently lead a kitchen and a small team
Passion for kitchen work and hands-on food preparation
requirements.question: What does 'passion for kitchen work and hands-on food preparation' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting emphasises passion for kitchen work without describing how it is demonstrated.

requirements.text: Skill in making tasty food from scratch with fresh ingredients
Development-focused leadership and ability to inspire others
requirements.question: What does 'development-focused leadership' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
